scripts.test:integration: uv run --package datapulse-server pytest apps/server/tests/connectors -m integration
scripts.generate:contracts: uv run --package datapulse-server python tools/export_schemas.py && node tools/generate_types.mjs
scripts.test: pnpm test:web && uv run --package datapulse-server pytest -m "not integration"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm typecheck:web && pnpm --filter @datapulse/schema exec tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.verify: pnpm check:contracts && pnpm test && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build
scripts.verify:full: pnpm verify && pnpm test:integration && pnpm test:e2e
